name: terraform-gcp
description: Create Terraform infrastructure for Google Cloud deployment
request_pattern: Create Terraform configuration for GCP. Deploy: ${resources}. Include: VPC network, firewall rules, service accounts with least privilege, GCS backend for state, variables.tf, outputs.tf, and a README. Use ${gcp_region} region.

variables.resources: Cloud Run service with Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and Cloud Storage bucket

guidelines: Never commit a service account key in plaintext
